notes.note: Extension wiring for the provider: map diffBoss.provider (default 'claude') to the registry from createDefaultRegistry(); pass diffBoss.model (default 'sonnet') to ClaudeAgentProvider; load the skill with loadSkill(path.join(context.extensionPath, 'skill')) — the .vsix ships skill/ at its root. Replace the placeholder smoke script: set package.json "smoke:live" to 'esbuild src/providers/smoke-live.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --packages=external --outfile=dist/smoke-live.mjs && node dist/smoke-live.mjs' and delete scripts/smoke-live.mjs if allowed by scope (otherwise report it).

ClaudeAgentProvider strips ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN from the SDK env, but Bedrock/Vertex switches and CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN still pass through. The real SDK call has not been exercised against a live login yet; pnpm smoke:live is the first live check.
